adds.title: BBC report (2004) and Miami Herald report (2019)
adds.summary: In July 2004 Cuban police in Havana targeted travestis wearing women's clothing for detention, issued municipal warnings to stop dressing as women, sanctioned three individuals under dangerousness law carrying up to four years imprisonment, closed private clubs hosting their shows, prohibited gay parties and denied entry to regular discos, forcing most to wear men's clothing in public and leading CENESEX to advise against appearing in women's clothing until the crackdown passed.
